primary_case: One 4.5-year randomized community trial found lower odds of increased photoaging with daily use
adversarial_test: Single trial in Australian adults under 55; 24% is relative odds rather than percent fewer wrinkles; no systemic anti-aging claim
final_action: Keep as core and correct the effect wording

primary_case: Directly reduce UV reaching skin and lower reliance on perfect sunscreen application
adversarial_test: Long-term photoaging RCT evidence for each item is sparse
final_action: Keep as first-line exposure reduction without a quantified aging effect

primary_case: International formula includes a high-UVA filter and can be a tolerable sunscreen implementation
adversarial_test: No head-to-head proof of superior clinical outcomes; Mexoryl 400 is not in the current U.S. monograph; sourcing and adherence matter
final_action: Describe as an optional implementation rather than a uniquely proven sunscreen

primary_case: Meta-analysis of 8 RCTs and 1361 participants supports improvement in photoaging signs
adversarial_test: Heterogeneous doses and scales; irritation; no proof of systemic anti-aging or skin-cancer prevention
final_action: Retain as an elective prescribed appearance module; do not place in universal care

primary_case: Controlled studies support hydration and barrier outcomes
adversarial_test: Small surrogate-endpoint studies do not prove ceramides or Aestura outperform all simple moisturizers
final_action: Keep category-level barrier support; brand remains flexible

primary_case: Small studies and a systematic review signal pigmentation and wrinkle improvement
adversarial_test: Only 7 publications and 139 volunteers; heterogeneous methods; no durable or product-specific outcome
final_action: Move from moderate support to a low-evidence optional experiment

primary_case: One new 28-day split-face study found benefits for a 0.1% PDRN eye cream
adversarial_test: Only 31 Chinese women; industry affiliations; different formulation and site; no Rejuran trial or long-term evidence
final_action: Keep experimental and add conflict and transferability warnings

primary_case: Manufacturer testing and class-level home-device studies suggest plausibility
adversarial_test: No independent peer-reviewed device-specific outcome trial; evidence from other RF or delivery devices cannot transfer
final_action: Keep insufficient and do not count as treatment

primary_case: Multiple RCTs and meta-analyses support diagnosed male androgenetic alopecia
adversarial_test: Indication-specific; adverse-effect counseling required; not for sudden or patchy shedding
final_action: Record as condition-specific therapy without a universal routine slot

primary_case: Small RCTs and meta-analysis suggest efficacy similar to topical minoxidil
adversarial_test: A 24-week 90-man RCT had 68 completers and no overall superiority; off-label; long-term safety uncertain
final_action: Record as low-evidence condition-specific therapy without a universal routine slot

primary_case: Short studies report dandruff and shedding-related outcomes
adversarial_test: Short industry-associated evidence and populations without confirmed AGA; far below hair-loss drugs
final_action: Use for actual dandruff or scalp symptoms rather than hair retention

primary_case: Reduces shaft friction and improves detangling and cosmetic breakage
adversarial_test: Sparse disease-outcome evidence and no follicle-growth effect
final_action: Judge by shaft performance and comfort

primary_case: Controlled moisturizer studies support xerosis symptom and barrier improvement
adversarial_test: No systemic or anti-aging outcome; exact brand superiority unproven
final_action: Use a tolerated cream or ointment for dryness

primary_case: Dermatology guidance supports warm short bathing gentle targeted cleansing and avoiding aggressive scrubbing when dryness is a concern
adversarial_test: Comparative evidence is inadequate to name one universal bathing frequency cleanser or immediate-moisturizer deadline
final_action: Use as a low-burden technique baseline rather than a product prescription

primary_case: Daily washing thorough drying and clean socks are standard prevention advice for odor and tinea risk
adversarial_test: Direct randomized prevention evidence in healthy adults is sparse
final_action: Add as ordinary hygiene with an honest low evidence rating

primary_case: Keeping nails clean and reasonably short and preserving cuticles plausibly reduces microbial burden trauma and paronychia risk
adversarial_test: Direct adult outcome trials are limited and do not justify cosmetic devices or supplements
final_action: Add as periodic maintenance rather than treatment

primary_case: Warm-water softening lubricant shaving with hair growth and a sharp clean blade are standard irritation-reduction practices
adversarial_test: Direct comparative trials are sparse and the routine treats grooming harm rather than broader health
final_action: Include as an as-needed recurring maintenance block without elevating aftershave or beard oil into treatments

primary_case: Guidelines synthesize strong evidence for caries prevention
adversarial_test: Evidence should not be broadened to all periodontal outcomes or all formulations
final_action: Keep twice-daily standard fluoride toothpaste as core

primary_case: Meta-analysis signals modest plaque and gingivitis benefit
adversarial_test: Older studies with high heterogeneity; current stabilization staining taste and tolerance matter
final_action: Keep as a reasonable formulation if tolerated

primary_case: Cochrane review found a modest average advantage for rotation-oscillation brushes
adversarial_test: High heterogeneity; no proof of long-term tooth retention; evidence does not transfer to every mechanism
final_action: Keep as support rather than a required purchase

primary_case: Network meta-analysis ranked water jets and interdental brushes well for short-term gingival outcomes
adversarial_test: Cochrane certainty is low or very low; short trials do not establish long-term periodontitis caries or tooth-loss superiority
final_action: Keep daily interdental care for the periodontal plan but make device selection conditional

primary_case: One small RCT found benefit when added to scaling and root planing
adversarial_test: Only 30 randomized with attrition and company funding; FDA device clearance does not establish medication efficacy
final_action: Record as a low-evidence condition-specific adjunct without a universal routine slot

primary_case: Guideline-based standard care for established periodontitis
adversarial_test: Not an at-home intervention; recall interval and response are individualized
final_action: Record as effective care for diagnosed periodontitis without a universal routine slot

primary_case: Seven double-blind sham-controlled RCTs pooled toward improved density
adversarial_test: Different devices wavelengths schedules and short follow-up; limited long-term combination evidence
final_action: Optional six-month photo-tracked experiment only after diagnosis and core therapy are stable

primary_case: Exposure science and prevention programs support reducing hazardous sound at the ear
adversarial_test: Real-world protection falls with poor fit and adherence; hard hearing-loss outcomes are inconsistent
final_action: Exposure-triggered core with fit instructions and a narrow exposure-reduction claim

primary_case: Strongly reduce ocular UV exposure and prevent acute photokeratitis
adversarial_test: Long-term cataract-prevention effect is largely observational rather than randomized
final_action: Use during meaningful outdoor UV exposure without promising a quantified disease reduction

primary_case: Safety standards and observational/policy data support impact and splash protection
adversarial_test: Few controlled trials and protection must match the hazard
final_action: Use Z87+ or other hazard-rated protection when relevant

primary_case: Filtration and fit evidence show substantial reduction of inhaled particles
adversarial_test: Clinical outcome trials are limited; wildfire field evidence is affected by fit facial hair and nonparticulate pollutants
final_action: Keep for smoke ash and dust while stating that it does not filter gases vapors or carbon monoxide

primary_case: Trials and systematic reviews show DEET picaridin and other registered actives reduce bites
adversarial_test: Malaria and other disease-outcome trials are inconsistent when adherence is poor or other controls dominate
final_action: Use as one exposure-triggered layer rather than a disease guarantee

primary_case: Meta-analyses associate mouthguard use with substantially fewer dental and orofacial injuries
adversarial_test: Underlying studies are mostly observational and concussion prevention is not established
final_action: Use a properly fitted guard for activities with meaningful dental-injury risk

primary_case: Community studies and public-health guidance support infection-risk reduction
adversarial_test: Effect size varies; compulsive over-washing can cause dermatitis; antibacterial ingredients add no proven consumer benefit
final_action: Use plain soap at relevant moments rather than adding antibacterial soap

primary_case: Wax removal can help true impaction or symptoms
adversarial_test: Guideline recommends no routine treatment of asymptomatic wax; swabs scopes and candles can injure or worsen impaction
final_action: Adopt a do-less guardrail and seek assessment for symptoms or modifying conditions

primary_case: Moisturizers can improve dry cracked heels
adversarial_test: No conclusive superiority of one active and no reason to treat asymptomatic feet
final_action: Conditional symptom care only

primary_case: Meta-analysis supports lower blood pressure when home measurements feed a treatment plan
adversarial_test: Monitoring alone showed no clear effect and can produce noise or anxiety
final_action: Use a validated upper-arm cuff only for elevated pressure diagnosis or clinician-integrated management

claim: Daily foot inspection in diabetes or neuropathy
primary_case: Guidelines recommend daily checks to identify injuries before ulcers progress
adversarial_test: Direct randomized health-outcome evidence is limited and the recommendation does not generalize to low-risk adults
final_action: Condition-triggered for diabetes neuropathy poor circulation or clinician-identified risk

primary_case: Guidelines support additional topical fluoride for elevated caries risk
adversarial_test: Strongest rinse evidence is pediatric; low-risk adults usually need only standard paste and fluoridated water
final_action: Dentist-triggered rather than universal

primary_case: Could plausibly find lesions earlier and increases self-exam behavior
adversarial_test: No demonstrated mortality or morbidity benefit; USPSTF evidence is insufficient and extra procedures are possible
final_action: Encourage lesion awareness and prompt assessment but not a universal schedule or app

primary_case: Marketed for screen strain sleep and retinal protection
adversarial_test: Seventeen randomized trials show little or no short-term visual benefit mixed sleep effects and no retinal-health evidence
final_action: Do not buy for an eye-health claim

primary_case: Marketed as more protective than plain soap
adversarial_test: FDA found inadequate evidence of superiority for consumer wash and removed multiple actives from the OTC category
final_action: Use plain soap and water

primary_case: Some studies report lower plaque mutans streptococci or caries
adversarial_test: Recent systematic reviews conflict and heterogeneity prevents a confident xylitol-specific caries claim
final_action: Optional sugar-free gum for saliva or preference; not a caries treatment

primary_case: Small studies report lower tongue coating or volatile sulfur compounds
adversarial_test: Tiny short trials and a 90-day RCT do not establish durable halitosis or disease prevention
final_action: Optional cosmetic use only when a personal breath or comfort benefit is observable
